name: alert
description: Noise and Alert (M5). Off: no Alert; the sysop is ACTIVE for the whole contract, as in the MVP.

name: revoke
description: The sysop's REVOKE intent on a node the player has access to (M5). The control that balances GHOST.

name: ghost
description: CLAIM or GHOST when AUTH falls (M5). The objective's ghost field sets it.

name: fog
description: Fog of war (M5). The objective's fog field sets it and gives the mode; forced on, an objective with fog off gets the mode on.

name: scan
description: SCAN as a network action (M5). Off: SCAN is refused.

name: jackOut
description: The JACK OUT action (M5). Off: JACK OUT is refused.

name: transfer
description: The objective's TARGET and its TRANSFER (M6). On when the objective has a target.

name: objectiveLoot
description: The objective's extraRewards in the loot pool (M6). On when the objective has extra rewards.
